name: Ubiquiti UniFi
author: Netlens
description: Reads the UniFi Network application (UniFi OS consoles such as Dream Machine, Cloud Gateway, or a self-hosted classic controller): gateway, switches, access points, which device hangs below which, every client's switch or access point with Wi-Fi signal and rate, each device's health and ports, the Wi-Fi channels and neighbouring networks, traffic per client and, with two internet connections, which one is in use. Read-only.

config.label: Controller address
config.help: The address you open UniFi at: https://<console> for a UniFi OS console (port 443), https://<server>:8443 for a classic self-hosted controller.

options.label: UniFi OS console (Dream Machine, Cloud Key Gen2+, Cloud Gateway)

config.label: Username
config.help: Use a separate local account with read-only access, without two-factor authentication (a cloud / Ubiquiti SSO account does not work).

config.label: Site
config.help: The name of one site as shown in UniFi (or its short id, usually default). Leave empty to read every site the account may see.

config.label: Read the Wi-Fi channels and neighbouring networks
config.help: Takes each access point's channel, width and busy airtime and the networks it hears from the controller (its own radio scans: nothing is interrupted). Netlens then says when a clearly quieter channel exists. Read-only. Needs Netlens 0.4.446.

config.label: Record configuration changes
config.help: Reads the networks, Wi-Fi networks (never the password), port forwards and firewall rules every sync and tells you when one of them changes. Read-only. Needs Netlens 0.4.387.

config.label: Verify TLS certificate
config.help: Checks that the certificate is signed by an authority this machine trusts. Turn this off only when the device uses its own self-signed certificate (many do until you install one).
